brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled for binary heart-disease detection: heart_disease_binary (0 vs 1) is a thresholded recoding of the ordinal angiography grade num (0 versus any 1-4), so per RL-0003 it is the sole target and num is a leakage suspect rather than a co-target; all other clinical measurements are legitimate pre-outcome features.
brief.repeated_subjects: No column identifies a repeated patient; each row is assumed to be one distinct patient.
brief.unit: one patient record from the Cleveland heart disease cohort
